item.title: Tara Sutaria hits back at 'bullies' after hugging, kissing AP Dhillon at concert; Veer Pahariya calls trolls 'jokers'
item.description: For the past two days, videos of Veer Pahariya and his actress girlfriend Tara Sutaria from AP Dhillon's Mumbai concert have been going viral. A clip showing AP Dhillon inviting Tara on stage and hugging and kissing her, while Veer watched from the audience, sparked online debate and breakup rumours.

item.title: World's patience with religious extremism in Pakistan wearing thin: Report
item.description: Anti-Pakistan sentiment is taking root in Western and Middle Eastern capitals, driven by alarm over Pakistan's export of radical Islamist ideology and its permissive attitude towards extremism and other criminal activities under the current military leadership.

item.title: DK Shivakumar will become K'taka CM on Jan 6 or 9; legislator Iqbal Hussain 200% sure
item.description: Speaking to reporters in Ramanagara, Iqbal Hussain, a staunch supporter of Deputy Chief Minister Shivakumar, said, "I am not saying this on my own. This has been said by 'sharanaru' (sages). Believing them, I am making this statement. I stand by what I have said."

item.title: Unnao rape case: 'Don't let hate bury the truth', pleads Sengar's daughter in viral open letter
item.description: The letter, addressed to the "Hon'ble Authorities of the Republic of India," comes hours after the Supreme Court stayed a Delhi High Court order that had suspended her father's life sentence and granted him conditional bail.

item.title: China, synthetic narcotics and political economy of proxy production in Southeast Asia
item.description: China's role in the synthetic drug trade fits this pattern. The state does not need to order chemical firms to supply traffickers if regulatory ambiguity and weak oversight already make such behaviour profitable and low risk.

item.title: Precious metals rebound as gold, silver recover after steep retreat
item.description: The pullback followed an early surge that saw gold touch $4,584 per troy ounce and silver climbed to $82.67 per ounce before both metals failed to hold gains. Analysts attributed the retreat largely to stretched long positions, a hike in margin requirements by the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) and thin holiday trading that amplified intraday swings.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty post mild losses amid sustained FPI outflows
item.description: Around 9.30 am, the Sensex moved down 115 points, or 0.14 per cent to 84,579 and the Nifty eased 30 points, or 0.12 per cent to 25,911. Main broad cap indices performed in line with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 declined 0.03 per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 lost 0.08 per cent.

item.title: PM Modi condoles demise of Khaleda Zia, says her contributions to India-Bangladesh relations will always be remembered
item.description: Begum Khaleda Zia passed away early Tuesday morning after a prolonged illness at the age of 80, her party confirmed. According to a statement issued by the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), she died at around 6 a.m. at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka, where she had been undergoing treatment for over a month.

item.title: Delhi-NCR suffers amid severe pollution, dense fog
item.description: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast "extremely dense fog" during the morning hours of December 30, followed by "dense fog" till the afternoon. The maximum temperature for the day was recorded at 21 degrees Celsius, while the minimum dropped to 8 degrees Celsius. Humidity levels reached 100 per cent, further worsening the foggy conditions.

item.title: Is Prabhas dating The Raja Saab co-star Riddhi Kumar? Fans refuse to believe, call it PR strategy
item.description: The trailer of Prabhas's upcoming film The Raja Saab was dropped on Monday, 29 December 2025, and ever since, rumours have been rife that the actor has found love. He is reportedly dating his The Raja Saab co-star Riddhi Kumar.
